sections.title: Ashta Chemma
sections.body:
A traditional Indian courtyard game, made by Shashank Bukka.
Built with the Godot Engine.

sections.title: Lettering
sections.body: Yatra One, Laila, Kalam and Ramaraja, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (licence files in assets/fonts).

sections.title: Sound
sections.body: Music and sounds made for the game from scratch, with SoX, FFmpeg, Python and FluidSynth. Instruments from the GeneralUser GS SoundFont by S. Christian Collins.

sections.title: Online rooms
sections.body: Room codes use Cloudflare quick tunnels through cloudflared (Apache License 2.0), fetched on hosts that need it.
